name: cl_B12
title: B12 cluster
description: Gas-phase B12. Photoelectron spectroscopy and ab initio calculations establish a quasi-planar C3v global minimum (Zhai et al., Nat. Mater. 2, 827 (2003)), with 3D isomers such as the icosahedron several eV higher. NEP89 reverses this ordering: its putative GM is the Ih icosahedron (B-B 1.73 A, the building block of bulk boron), 2.7 eV below the relaxed quasi-planar C3v structure, so this benchmark probes search on the NEP89 landscape rather than boron-cluster chemistry.
